title: wooddeck .deck file — envelope v2
description: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for the wooddeck .deck v2 file format. v2 adds Epic 2's foundation model: the design payload REQUIRES `structure` (elevated | floating) and `foundation` (discriminated union on `type`). The pre-S17 top-level `post` field was REMOVED in this schema (review-gate FIX 2) — `foundation.post` (inside the posts-on-footings variant) is now the SINGLE source of truth for the post material. `additionalProperties:false` on `DeckDesign` rejects a leftover top-level `post`, so a v1 file must go through migrateV1ToV2 before v2 validation. The envelope stays lenient at the root (no additionalProperties:false) so a future v3 producer may append additive metadata; the design payload is strict (additionalProperties:false at every level) so unknown fields are rejected, never silently dropped. Loader logic MUST switch on `schema` and refuse any value other than 2 (with v1 migration handled by a separate loader path).

schema.description: Envelope version. Frozen at 2 for the Epic 2 release; a new major format is a new schema number.

generator.description: Producing application identifier — always the literal string 'wooddeck'.

generatorVersion.description: SemVer version of the producing wooddeck build (from package.json at build time). Pattern accepts MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional -prerelease and/or +build suffix (both suffix segments are folded together in the pattern for simplicity).

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time at which the file was produced.

structure.description: FR-027 structure enum — elevated (posts on grade) or floating (deck on grade).

floatingFraming.description: S26 (fix/floating-framing-joists) — OPTIONAL discriminator that selects the framing method for a floating deck. `beams-and-joists` (default) puts rim beams over blocks with joists on top at `joist.spacingMm`; `joists-on-blocks` places joists directly on blocks with no beam layer. IGNORED for elevated designs — the loader always sets the field to `beams-and-joists` (the default) if it is absent, so downstream consumers can treat it as required after `deserialize`. Optional so v2 files written before S26 remain load-compatible; when omitted the loader stamps the default (see `src/persistence/deck-file/schema-v2.ts`).

beamConnection.description: S27 (feat/joist-beam-connection) — OPTIONAL discriminator that selects the joist-to-beam connection geometry. `drop` (default; pre-S27 behavior) puts joists ON TOP of beams (joistBottomY === beamTopY). `flush` hangs joists on the SIDE of beams via joist hangers so joist TOP is level with beam TOP (joistTopY === beamTopY) — yields a shorter deck stack. Only meaningful when the design has BOTH beams AND joists: elevated (all foundation types) OR floating Method A (`floatingFraming` === `beams-and-joists`). IGNORED for floating Method B (`joists-on-blocks`; no beam layer). Optional so v2 files written before S27 remain load-compatible; when omitted the loader stamps the default `drop` (see `finalizeBeamConnection` in `src/persistence/deck-file/schema-v2.ts`).

FoundationSpec.description: FR-026 foundation discriminated union. Discriminator: `type`. Each variant carries only the fields its type requires; additionalProperties:false at each variant defends against prototype pollution and typo drift.

blockRowsHint.description: S25 (ticket #47) — OPTIONAL override for the derived block-row count under a floating deck. Dimensionless positive integer; the runtime layout clamps to [2, floor(lengthMm / MIN_BLOCK_SPACING_MM) + 1]. minimum=2 mirrors the perimeter-two AC4 lower bound; maximum=100 is a generous fixed ceiling well above any physically-sensible grid (a 100-row grid on a 40 ft deck yields ~120 mm block spacing, below the 300 mm runtime density cap — the runtime clamp will reject it further). Omit for the S19 derivation (byte-identical to pre-S25).

blockColsHint.description: S25 (ticket #47) — OPTIONAL override for the derived block-column count under a floating deck. Dimensionless positive integer; the runtime layout clamps to [2, floor(widthMm / MIN_BLOCK_SPACING_MM) + 1]. See blockRowsHint for the bounds rationale. Omit for the S19 derivation.

blockRowsHint.description: S25 (ticket #47) — OPTIONAL override for the derived block-row count under a floating deck. Dimensionless positive integer; the runtime layout clamps to [2, floor(lengthMm / MIN_BLOCK_SPACING_MM) + 1]. minimum=2 mirrors the perimeter-two AC4 lower bound; maximum=100 is a generous fixed ceiling well above any physically-sensible grid. Omit for the S19 derivation (byte-identical to pre-S25).

blockColsHint.description: S25 (ticket #47) — OPTIONAL override for the derived block-column count under a floating deck. Dimensionless positive integer; the runtime layout clamps to [2, floor(widthMm / MIN_BLOCK_SPACING_MM) + 1]. See blockRowsHint for the bounds rationale. Omit for the S19 derivation.

FootingSpec.description: Poured-concrete footing dimensions for posts-on-footings foundations. Values are typical residential-deck sizes (300 mm ≈ 12" default).

FoundationBlockRef.description: SKU reference into the S17 foundation catalog. `productId` enum is pinned to the persistence-side FOUNDATION_PRODUCT_IDS constant (schema-constants.ts) which is compile-time equated to FoundationProductId (AC8).

Mm.description: Canonical millimeter length — finite non-negative number.
